title: 真实槽覆盖缺口：PING正常仍可能拒绝业务，按所需键分别验收部分可用性
source: OpsForge 原创编审 2026-10-21；Redis官方文档核对
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
body:
## 操作任务
实现check_readiness(command,keys,error_type)。keys是非空list且每项为非空字符串，error_type为明确的服务端错误Exception子类，否则ValueError。仅按顺序逐项GET已批准业务键，保留重复、nil与空串；成功记录{key,status:"readable",value}，捕获指定服务端错误记录{key,status:"rejected",code:错误原文第一个单词或UNKNOWN}，其他异常原样传播。返回{ready:所有键均可读,results:有序逐项记录}。nil是合法缺键，不能据此判不可用；PING、任一键成功、cluster_state=ok都不能代替所有必要业务键验收。不得修改配置、槽位或数据。原生验收在两个在线私有master间移除一个槽映射：full-coverage=yes时连有覆盖键也拒绝，no时可读已覆盖键但无覆盖键仍失败；随后恢复原槽和策略核对数据。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Redis7.2双master完整槽与单槽缺口对照；所有进程持续在线，隔离测试器只修改自有临时集群映射及策略并恢复。不是生产HA拓扑，不代表网络分区、真实节点丢失、failover或少数派仍可写；允许部分可用性必须由业务另行批准，学员函数只读验收而不擅自关闭full-coverage。
rubric: 核心机制准确，说明适用前提
给出可观察的验收结果并说明必要边界

import sys,os,pathlib,time,copy
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()));sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from redis_native import RedisError,student
from redis_cluster_native import Cluster
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
with Cluster() as cluster:
 source,target=cluster.source,cluster.target
 goodtag,goodslot=cluster.tag();gaptag,gapslot=cluster.tag()
 good='{'+goodtag+'}:exists';empty='{'+goodtag+'}:missing';gap='{'+gaptag+'}:exists'
 source.command('SET',good,'preserved-business');source.command('SET',gap,'preserved-gap-slot')
 def await_state(state,assigned):
  end=time.monotonic()+7
  while time.monotonic()<end:
   rows=[dict(line.split(':',1) for line in peer.command('CLUSTER','INFO').splitlines() if ':' in line) for peer in (source,target)]
   if all(row.get('cluster_state')==state and row.get('cluster_slots_assigned')==str(assigned) for row in rows):return
   time.sleep(.02)
  raise RuntimeError('owned slot-coverage state did not converge')
 def run(keys):
  original=list(keys);calls=[];policies=[peer.command('CONFIG','GET','cluster-require-full-coverage') for peer in (source,target)]
  def query(*parts):
   assert len(parts)==2 and parts[0]=='GET' and parts[1] in keys,'readiness must only read approved keys'
   calls.append(parts[1]);return source.command(*parts)
  out=student(task.check_readiness,query,keys,RedisError)
  assert keys==original and calls==original
  assert policies==[peer.command('CONFIG','GET','cluster-require-full-coverage') for peer in (source,target)]
  return out
 healthy=run([good,empty,good]);assert healthy=={'ready':True,'results':[{'key':good,'status':'readable','value':'preserved-business'},{'key':empty,'status':'readable','value':None},{'key':good,'status':'readable','value':'preserved-business'}]},healthy
 source.command('CLUSTER','DELSLOTS',gapslot);target.command('CLUSTER','DELSLOTS',gapslot)
 await_state('fail',16383)
 assert source.command('PING')==target.command('PING')=='PONG'
 denied=run([good,empty]);assert denied['ready'] is False and all(row['status']=='rejected' and row['code']=='CLUSTERDOWN' for row in denied['results']),denied
 print('NATIVE_REDIS_GAP_WITH_FULL_COVERAGE_PONG_BUT_HEALTHY_SLOT_DENIED',flush=True)
 for peer in (source,target):peer.command('CONFIG','SET','cluster-require-full-coverage','no')
 await_state('ok',16383)
 partial=run([good,gap,empty]);assert partial=={'ready':False,'results':[{'key':good,'status':'readable','value':'preserved-business'},{'key':gap,'status':'rejected','code':'CLUSTERDOWN'},{'key':empty,'status':'readable','value':None}]},partial
 assert run([good,empty])['ready'] is True
 print('NATIVE_REDIS_PARTIAL_COVERAGE_ONLY_ASSIGNED_BUSINESS_SLOTS_READABLE',flush=True)
 source.command('CLUSTER','ADDSLOTS',gapslot);target.command('CLUSTER','SETSLOT',gapslot,'NODE',cluster.source_id)
 for peer in (source,target):peer.command('CONFIG','SET','cluster-require-full-coverage','yes')
 await_state('ok',16384)
 restored=run([good,gap]);assert restored['ready'] is True and restored['results'][1]['value']=='preserved-gap-slot',restored
 for keys in ([],[''],[None]):
  try:task.check_readiness(source.command,keys,RedisError)
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('invalid key scope accepted')
 def disconnected(*args):raise ConnectionError('owned client disconnected')
 try:task.check_readiness(disconnected,[good],RedisError)
 except ConnectionError:pass
 else:raise AssertionError('transport failure confused with Redis server rejection')
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
